actingctl_usage_invalid.description: actingctl was given arguments its usage does not allow: an unknown command or option, a missing or repeated value, or a value out of range. argument and argument_problem name the argument and the rule when one argument is at fault, range_min and range_max the allowed range, and variable an invalid ACTINGCOMMAND_DETAIL. Exit 1.
actingctl_usage_invalid.common_causes: A misspelt command or option, or a caller written for another release.
actingctl_usage_invalid.handling: Correct the command line; actingctl without arguments prints its usage.

actingctl_package_resolution_failed.description: actingctl could not resolve the contained task package of task-run.

actingctl_fact_record_invalid.description: actingctl could not read a bounded fact observation file, or it is invalid.

actingctl_output_failed.description: actingctl could not write its JSON output line: serialising the result failed or stdout could not be written. Exit 1.
actingctl_output_failed.common_causes: stdout closed early by the caller (a broken pipe), or a defect in the result's serialisation.
actingctl_output_failed.handling: Keep the reader of actingctl's stdout open until it exits; report it when it repeats.

resource_targets_file_invalid.description: agent-apply-resource-targets: the policy file is unreadable, empty, too large or not UTF-8.

task_offset_scope_ambiguous.description: task-offset without --instance: the registered instances do not name exactly one configured game.

clock_unavailable.description: The system clock is before the Unix epoch or out of range.

config_facts_missing.description: status --config: the runtime fact snapshot holds no config.subsystems or config.parameters record.

shutdown_wait_timeout.description: actingctl request-shutdown --wait or install-transition --wait: the accepted owner did not close and exit within timeout_ms. pid and owner_epoch name the owner; owner_closed and process_alive are what the wait last saw, and a failed process probe is the caused_by link. Exit 1.
shutdown_wait_timeout.common_causes: Work in flight that takes longer than the wait to drain, a Runtime that hangs while closing, or a wait set too short.
shutdown_wait_timeout.handling: Run actingctl status to see whether the Runtime still answers; wait longer, or check the Runtime's log for what holds it.

shutdown_wait_journal_unreadable.description: actingctl's shutdown wait could not read the owner journal under the state root: path names the file, line the record that does not decode, and the decoder's or the OS error is the caused_by link. Exit 1.
shutdown_wait_journal_unreadable.common_causes: A journal written by another release, a damaged journal file, or a state root the process may not read.
shutdown_wait_journal_unreadable.handling: Check the state root the configuration names and its owner journal; run actingctl status to see the Runtime's state.

arguments_invalid.description: An MCP tool was called with arguments its input schema refuses.

tier_not_enabled.description: An MCP tool of a tier this server was not started with was called. U-3 retires this code when the tiers go.

output_budget_exceeded.description: An MCP tool result is larger than the tool output budget.

job_capacity_exhausted.description: The MCP server holds as many jobs as it may.

job_start_failed.description: The MCP server could not start a job thread.

call_budget_exhausted.description: An MCP call reached the end of its time budget.

handle_unknown.description: No job of this MCP server process has the handle.

since_out_of_range.description: ac_diagnose: since_unix_ms is further back than the window allows.

errors_query_invalid.description: ac_diagnose could not form its errors view query.

cursor_invalid.description: An MCP cursor belongs to another query, Runtime connection or server process.

cursor_encode_failed.description: The MCP server could not encode a cursor.

instance_ambiguous.description: An instance selector names more than one configured instance.

install_build_manifest_unreadable.description: actingctl overview or ac_overview could not read the install's build manifest.

install_state_root_unresolved.description: The MCP server cannot tell the Runtime state root.

install_process_root_mismatch.description: mcp-serve --root names another install root than the process runs from.

install_process_state_root_mismatch.description: mcp-serve --state-root names another state root than the install's configuration.

install_root_unresolved.description: actingctl does not run from an install root and mcp-serve got no --root.

material_ref_invalid.description: ac_material: ref is not a materials[].ref of ac_events.

material_ref_unknown.description: ac_material: the ledger holds no such event and material at this sequence.

material_query_invalid.description: ac_material could not form its event query.

material_not_text.description: ac_material: the material is not text at this offset.

material_too_large.description: ac_material: the material is larger than an export may be.

material_export_failed.description: The MCP server could not write an export file.

run_unknown.description: ac_stop_run: no run of this server has the handle; actingctl run evidence and ac_run_evidence: no contained run has the request_id (request_id) or the run_id given (run_state not_found).

resource_targets_document_too_large.description: ac_targets_set: the policy document is larger than its bound.

lab_tool_unavailable.description: The install's actinglab cannot be found.

lab_process_failed.description: actinglab could not run, or answered without a usable envelope.

lab_process_timeout.description: actinglab was still running at the end of the call budget.

answer_exported.description: An answer larger than the output budget was written whole to an export file.

client_action_without_req_id.description: actinglab's answer carried no req_id for the call's client.action.

client_action_not_recorded.description: Recording the call's client.action in the Runtime failed after actinglab answered.

binding_requires_unavailable.description: ac_binding_draft: the answer carries no binding_requires.

preflight_failed.description: ac_binding_draft: actinglab package preflight did not pass the recorded package.

check_config_unavailable.description: ac_binding_draft: actingd check-config gave no report.

check_config_failed.description: actingd check-config could not run or printed no JSON report.

suspended_report_reader_panicked.description: The reader of actingd's suspended report panicked.

suspended_report_spawn_failed.description: actingd suspended could not be started.

suspended_report_timeout.description: actingd suspended was still running at the end of the call budget.

suspended_report_state_root_mismatch.description: actingd suspended read another state root than this server.

suspended_report_unreadable.description: actingd suspended printed no JSON report.

mcp_workers_unavailable.description: The MCP server has no worker thread for the call.

mcp_tool_panicked.description: An MCP tool call panicked; the server goes on.

watchdog_alive.description: Watchdog decision: the Runtime owner answers.

watchdog_formal_close.description: Watchdog decision: the last owner closed formally.

watchdog_grace.description: Watchdog decision: a start waits out the grace after a gap.

watchdog_installer_busy.description: Watchdog decision: the installer holds the writer lock.

watchdog_never_started.description: Watchdog decision: the state root holds no owner record.

watchdog_owner_lock_held.description: Watchdog decision: the owner lock is held by an owner that does not answer.

watchdog_run_in_progress.description: Watchdog decision: another tick holds the run lock.

watchdog_runtime_process_present.description: Watchdog decision: a Runtime process runs without the owner lock.

watchdog_selection_changed.description: Watchdog decision: the install selection changed during the tick.

watchdog_started_runtime.description: Watchdog decision: the watchdog started the Runtime.

watchdog_misconfigured.description: Watchdog decision: the watchdog is misconfigured.

watchdog_start_failed.description: Watchdog decision: the watchdog's start of the Runtime failed.

watchdog_owner_retained_unconfirmed.description: Watchdog decision: the last owner was retained with its resources unconfirmed.

watchdog_runtime_process_without_owner.description: Watchdog decision: a Runtime process has run without the owner lock for too long.

watchdog_budget_exhausted.description: Watchdog decision: the restart budget is exhausted.

watchdog_fatal_hold.description: Watchdog decision: the Runtime's last start ended fatally; it is held until an external fix.

watchdog_formal_start_observed.description: The watchdog observed a formal start of the Runtime.

watchdog_state_reset.description: The watchdog set its state file aside and started a fresh state.

watchdog_config_unreadable.description: The watchdog cannot read the selected configuration.

watchdog_directory_unavailable.description: The watchdog cannot create its directory.

watchdog_journal_unreadable.description: The watchdog cannot read the owner journal.

watchdog_journal_unrecognised.description: The watchdog does not recognise the owner journal's records.

watchdog_launcher_missing.description: The watchdog's launcher or entry program is not a file.

watchdog_layout_unknown.description: The watchdog does not recognise the install root's layout.

watchdog_log_directory_unreadable.description: The watchdog cannot read a log directory.

watchdog_log_unreadable.description: The watchdog cannot read a Runtime log.

watchdog_log_unwritable.description: The watchdog cannot write its log.

watchdog_root_mismatch.description: The watchdog's root is not the install root the selection names.

watchdog_root_unavailable.description: The watchdog's root cannot be resolved.

watchdog_run_lock_failed.description: The watchdog cannot take its run lock.

watchdog_state_root_invalid.description: The selected configuration names no usable state root.

watchdog_state_unreadable.description: The watchdog cannot read its state file.

watchdog_state_unwritable.description: The watchdog cannot write its state file.

watchdog_task_mismatch.description: Task Scheduler holds another definition than the watchdog's.

watchdog_task_query_failed.description: Reading the watchdog task from Task Scheduler failed.

watchdog_user_unavailable.description: The watchdog cannot tell the current user.

watchdog_wmi_path_unsafe.description: A start path holds a character the WMI start cannot carry safely.

watchdog_writer_lock_failed.description: The watchdog cannot probe the installer's writer lock.

entry_missing.description: The watchdog's start found no Runtime entry program.

log_create_failed.description: The watchdog's start could not create the Runtime log.

spawn_failed.description: The watchdog's start could not spawn the Runtime.

wmi_start_failed.description: The watchdog's WMI start of the Runtime failed.

exited_during_startup.description: The Runtime the watchdog started exited before it answered.

start_timeout.description: The Runtime the watchdog started did not answer in time.

lab_tool_option_disabled.description: mcp-serve was called for a Lab option tool whose option is not installed: a tool that tools/list did not list, or one whose option was switched off after the session listed it (each call checks the options again). No actinglab child process starts. lab_option names the option; mcp_blocker is installer_lab_option.
lab_tool_option_disabled.common_causes: The Lab option was not ticked in the installer, or was removed while an agent session was open.
lab_tool_option_disabled.handling: Tick the option on the installer's Lab page. The tool list changes from the next MCP session.

mcp_tier_retired.description: mcp-serve was started with the retired --tier argument. MCP has no tiers from #389 U-3 on: the server starts as usual with every general tool and the tools of the installed Lab options, and reports this once on stderr and in the tools/list warnings.
mcp_tier_retired.common_causes: A harness configuration written before #389 U-3.
mcp_tier_retired.handling: Remove --tier from the harness configuration; actingctl mcp-config prints the current form.

package_binding_unreadable.description: actingctl packs or ac_packs found a package binding of the selected configuration whose path does not exist or cannot be read (a package folder bound as a startup package also needs a control.json naming its package_id); the row says readable false and the rest of the answer is read as usual. alias names the instance of a per-instance binding.

config_generation_mismatch.description: actingctl overview or ac_overview found that the configuration generation actingd runs is not the one the installation selects now; path is the selected configuration, which takes effect only when actingd is restarted. The rest of the overview is read as usual.

outcome_codes_reported.description: actingctl codes: the catalog entry of one outcome code, or one page of the code list, was printed from the outcome catalog this build embeds, as ac_outcome_code answers it (Workflow #389 MCP-14).

outcome_code_unknown.description: actingctl codes or ac_outcome_code was asked for a code (code_name, unless it is no word a name may hold) that the outcome catalog this build embeds does not list.

outcome_catalog_unreadable.description: actingctl codes or ac_outcome_code could not read the outcome catalog this build embeds: it does not parse, has no codes table, or an entry lacks a member the answer reads (a build defect). The decoder's failure is its cause when there is one.

run_evidence_reported.description: actingctl run evidence: one page of a contained run's steps (page, recognised targets, input, frame refs), its final page and frame and its overlay ref was printed, read from the run's ledger events, as ac_run_evidence answers it (Workflow #389 MCP-6).

start_runtime_already_running.description: actingctl start or restart: a live process holds the owner lock of the state root (path), so nothing was started and nothing was changed.

start_wait_idle_expired.description: actingctl restart: after --wait-idle (timeout_ms) the instances named in aliases still held a lease or queued requests, so nothing was stopped.

agent_facts_published.description: actingctl agent-publish-facts: the Runtime recorded the fact observation.

resource_targets_applied.description: actingctl agent-apply-resource-targets: the Runtime applied the resource target policy.

task_offset_published.description: actingctl task-offset: the Runtime recorded the manual priority offset.

runtime_shutdown_requested.description: actingctl request-shutdown: the Runtime accepted the shutdown request; the result carries its receipt. Exit 0. Without --wait, actingctl does not wait for the process to end.
runtime_shutdown_requested.common_causes: A shutdown request to a running Runtime.
runtime_shutdown_requested.handling: None; pass --wait to wait for the owner to close and the process to exit.

runtime_shutdown_completed.description: actingctl request-shutdown --wait: the Runtime accepted the shutdown, its owner record closed and its process exited within the wait; the result carries the receipt and the shutdown observation. Exit 0.
runtime_shutdown_completed.common_causes: A shutdown of a running Runtime that finished in time.

install_transition_reported.description: actingctl install-transition: the Runtime answered the transition action. transition_id names the transition and phase the phase the Runtime reports (draining, drained, held, preparing or released); a commit's receipt, the accepted shutdown, reports no phase. Exit 0.
install_transition_reported.common_causes: An install-transition action the Runtime accepted.
install_transition_reported.handling: None; the installer continues with the next action for the reported phase.

install_transition_failed.description: actingctl install-transition: the Runtime reports the transition in phase failed, with admission closed. transition_id names the transition; the transition's failure code is the caused_by link. Exit 1.
install_transition_failed.common_causes: A held or released start that timed out (held_timeout, release_timeout), whose preparation failed, or that a latched failure stopped.
install_transition_failed.handling: Read the caused_by link and the Runtime's log; the installer ends the transition and starts the previous Runtime again.

install_transition_aborted.description: actingctl install-transition: the Runtime reports the transition in phase aborted: the drain ended and admission reopened on the old owner. transition_id names the transition; the failure code, when the transition has one (drain_timeout), is the caused_by link. Exit 1.
install_transition_aborted.common_causes: A drain that did not finish before its deadline, or an Abort action.
install_transition_aborted.handling: Wait until running work finishes, or give the drain a longer timeout, then begin a new transition.

instance_reset_done.description: actingctl reset: the Runtime reset the instance.

instance_observed.description: actingctl observe: the Runtime took one read-only frame of the instance.

runtime_status_reported.description: actingctl status: the Runtime answered its status, which the result carries. Exit 0.
runtime_status_reported.common_causes: A status read of a running Runtime.

runtime_config_reported.description: actingctl status --config: the config.* records of the runtime fact snapshot were printed.

config_settings_changed.description: actingctl config set|clear: the Runtime applied every change.

runtime_facts_reported.description: actingctl facts --program: the runtime fact snapshot was printed.

monitor_status_reported.description: actingctl monitor-status: the Runtime reported its monitor registry.

monitor_policy_set.description: actingctl monitor-set: the Runtime took the instance's monitor policy.

monitor_policy_cleared.description: actingctl monitor-clear: the Runtime cleared the instance's monitor policy.

instance_status_reported.description: actingctl emulator status: the instance's row of the Runtime status was printed.

instance_emulator_controlled.description: actingctl emulator start|stop|restart: the Runtime completed the emulator control.

instances_discovered.description: actingctl emulator discover: the Runtime ran one emulator instance discovery and listed the instances; count is how many. Exit 0.
instances_discovered.common_causes: A discovery of a running Runtime with an emulator provider.

runtime_scheduling_paused.description: actingctl pause: the Runtime paused scheduling (globally or for the instance).

runtime_scheduling_resumed.description: actingctl resume: the Runtime lifted the scheduling pause.

instance_self_check_reported.description: actingctl selfcheck: the instance reconnected and its self-check passed.

instance_self_check_failed.description: actingctl selfcheck: the instance's reconnect or self-check failed; its failure code, when the result gives one, is the caused_by link.

instance_frames_captured.description: actingctl stream: the Runtime captured the frame sequence.

task_run_reported.description: actingctl task-run: the contained run completed.

runtime_events_reported.description: actingctl events: one page of ledger events was printed.

instance_frame_exported.description: actingctl observe --export: the observed frame was read back verified and written to the export folder.

run_list_reported.description: actingctl runs: one page of the run list was printed.

instance_facts_reported.description: actingctl facts --instance: one instance's facts (InstanceFactSnapshot) were printed, as ac_facts with scope instance answers them (Workflow #389 MCP-4).

runtime_diagnosis_reported.description: actingctl diagnose: the diagnosis of the window was printed.

runtime_overview_reported.description: actingctl overview: the overview was printed, as ac_overview answers it (Workflow #389 MCP-8).

package_bindings_reported.description: actingctl packs: the bound packages of the selected configuration were printed.

start_runtime_started.description: actingctl start: the Runtime was started and its owner answers; log is the start's log file.

start_runtime_restarted.description: actingctl restart: the Runtime was stopped and started again and its owner answers; log is the start's log file.

start_runtime_refused.description: actingctl start or restart refused to start the Runtime; the watchdog condition that refused it (installer busy, a tick in progress) is the caused_by link.

material_unavailable.description: The Runtime answered a material read without the material: material_state is the read state and material_limit why it stopped short; the Runtime's typed failure code, when it gave one, is the caused_by link.

suspended_report_failed.description: actingd suspended exited with its own failure report; that report's outcome is the caused_by link and its stderr tail a related foreign_other_error link.

lab_tool_failed.description: actinglab answered an error envelope; exit_code is its exit code, its code is the first caused_by link and, when the error has details, a foreign_other_error link (raw_source process) holds those details' JSON as raw_text.

mcp_params_invalid.description: JSON-RPC -32602: a params or _meta member of an MCP request is missing, of the wrong type or not recognised (argument names it).

mcp_message_malformed.description: JSON-RPC -32700: an MCP message line is not JSON; the parser's error is the caused_by link.

mcp_message_too_large.description: JSON-RPC -32700: an MCP message line is longer than limit_bytes and was skipped.

mcp_batch_empty.description: JSON-RPC -32600: an MCP batch array was empty.

mcp_batch_unsupported.description: JSON-RPC -32600: a batch array arrived outside a session initialized with protocol 2025-03-26.

mcp_request_invalid.description: JSON-RPC -32600: an MCP message is not a JSON-RPC 2.0 request or notification.

mcp_method_unknown.description: JSON-RPC -32601: mcp-serve has no such method.

mcp_protocol_version_unsupported.description: JSON-RPC -32022: a request's _meta names a protocol version mcp-serve does not take that way; data lists the supported versions.

mcp_protocol_version_missing.description: JSON-RPC -32602: a request neither follows a legacy initialize nor carries the _meta protocol version and client capabilities.

mcp_request_id_in_use.description: JSON-RPC -32600: a tools/call request with this id is still in flight.

mcp_server_start_failed.description: mcp-serve could not start one of its threads (thread); the OS error is the caused_by link.

mcp_input_failed.description: mcp-serve could not read stdin and ended; the OS error is the caused_by link.

mcp_file_too_large.description: mcp-serve, or actingctl overview reading the build manifest, read a file (a configuration, a manifest, an export) larger than its bound limit_bytes.

mcp_config_program_unresolved.description: actingctl mcp-config cannot name the program a client registers: the executable or the installation selection cannot be read, or a slot's fixed entry is missing.

mcp_config_program_unsupported.description: actingctl mcp-config cannot write the client configuration for this program path (not Unicode, or a double quote for claude).

mcp_identity_card_refused.description: The Runtime refused mcp-serve's governance identity card (governance.allowed_clients); the write went ahead without it and the refusal is the caused_by link.

watchdog_start_due.description: Watchdog decision (status): run-once would start the Runtime now.

watchdog_start_pending.description: Watchdog state: a start whose result is not known yet.

watchdog_owner_lock_unanswered.description: Watchdog status attention: the owner lock has been held for elapsed_ms (10 minutes or more) without an answering owner.

watchdog_formal_close_unlogged.description: Watchdog status attention: no Runtime log covers the formally closed owner epoch, so a fatal stop of an unlogged start may be hidden.

watchdog_last_start_failed.description: Watchdog status attention: the last watchdog start (at_unix_ms) failed; its start result is the caused_by link.

watchdog_restarts_repeated.description: Watchdog status attention: the watchdog started the Runtime count times (2 or more) within a day.

watchdog_task_missing.description: Watchdog status attention: no watchdog task (name) is registered for this root.

watchdog_install_refused.description: actingctl watchdog install refused; the condition that refused it (installer busy, a tick in progress) is the caused_by link.

watchdog_launcher_misplaced.description: actingwatch is not <root>\tools\actingwatch.exe, so it knows no installation root.

watchdog_launcher_writer_lock_failed.description: actingwatch cannot probe the installation writer lock.

watchdog_launcher_spawn_failed.description: actingwatch cannot run the watchdog tick (<root>\runtime\actingctl.exe).

recovery_ladder_drill_queued.description: actingctl ladder-drill: the Runtime admitted a drill of the instance's stuck-recovery ladder and queued its claim; the line carries the drill {instance_alias, mode, ladder_request_id}, as ac_ladder_drill answers it (Workflow #390 DRILL-1).
